hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager
hook.description: Token-launch hook built on the Flaunch protocol that creates paired-token pools with creator-set swap fees (1.5–5%) taken via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas and distributed to a fee escrow and optional referrers. Supports scheduled launches (swaps gated by block.timestamp until a set flaunch time), optional pre-buys at launch, and an internal swap pool that fills orders from accumulated fee inventory before routing to the Uniswap pool.
